info.title: Med Market API
info.description: B2B Medical Delivery System API Documentation

post.description: Creates a new user account and returns an authentication token
Authenticate user and return access token. Rate limited to 5 requests per minute.

get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user with company information
Get the current user's shopping cart with all items

delete.description: Remove all items from the shopping cart

post.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. The unit_price is automatically calculated using the product's pharmacist_price with any applicable discounts applied.

product_id.description: Product ID to add to cart

200.description: Item added to cart successfully. Price uses product pharmacist_price with discounts applied.

403.description: Forbidden - Only buyers can add items to cart

put.description: Update quantity or notes of a cart item

delete.description: Remove an item from the shopping cart

post.description: Convert cart items to orders. If cart contains items from multiple suppliers, multiple orders will be created automatically (one per supplier). All orders are created in a single atomic transaction - either all succeed or all fail. Cart is cleared after successful checkout.

200.description: Orders created successfully. Returns array of orders if multiple suppliers, single order if one supplier.

message.example: Cart checked out. Multiple orders created for different suppliers.

items.description: Order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships

get.description: Get a paginated list of companies

post.description: Create a new company. Only admins can create companies.

403.description: Forbidden - Only admins can create companies

get.description: Get details of a specific company

put.description: Update company details. Only admins can update companies.

delete.description: Soft delete a company. Only admins can delete companies.

get.description: Get a paginated list of drivers. Suppliers see only their company drivers.

post.description: Create a new driver (suppliers and admins only)

get.description: Get details of a specific driver
Get all orders assigned to a specific driver
Get a paginated list of offers. Suppliers see only their offers, buyers see all active offers.

post.description: Create a new product offer or promotion (suppliers only)

get.description: Get details of a specific offer

put.description: Update an existing offer (suppliers can only update their own offers)

delete.description: Delete an offer (soft delete, suppliers can only delete their own offers)

get.description: Get a paginated list of orders. Filtered by user's company.

post.description: Create a new order. Only buyers can create orders. If unit_price is not provided, it will use the product's pharmacist_price with any applicable discounts applied (getFinalPharmacistPrice method).

unit_price.description: Optional - will use product pharmacist_price with discounts applied (getFinalPharmacistPrice) if not provided

201.description: Order created successfully. Order includes buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships.

403.description: Forbidden - Only buyers can create orders

get.description: Get details of a specific order including buyerCompany, supplierCompany, creator, items.product, statusLogs.user, and driver (if assigned)

200.description: Order retrieved successfully. Includes all relationships and driver information if assigned.

post.description: Transition order to a new status. Valid transitions are enforced.
Cancel an order. Requires cancellation reason.

400.description: Cannot cancel order in current status

post.description: Assign a driver to an order. Only suppliers can assign drivers to their own orders. The driver must belong to the supplier's company.

200.description: Driver assigned successfully. Order includes driver relationship.

403.description: Forbidden - Only suppliers can assign drivers to their own orders

get.description: Get a paginated list of products. Suppliers see only their products, buyers see all active products. Products include category, dual pricing (pharmacist_price, customer_price), and discount information.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search in name, SKU, description, or category

200.description: Products retrieved successfully. Each product includes category, pharmacist_price, customer_price, discount, and discount_type fields.

post.description: Create a new product. Only suppliers can create products.

price.description: Legacy field - kept for backward compatibility. Use pharmacist_price instead.

pharmacist_price.description: Selling price for pharmacists/buyers. Required if price is not provided.

discount.description: Discount amount (percentage or fixed based on discount_type)

discount_type.description: Type of discount: percentage or fixed amount

metadata.description: Additional product information as JSON object

403.description: Forbidden - Only suppliers can create products

get.description: Get details of a specific product including category, dual pricing (pharmacist_price, customer_price), discount, and discount_type

200.description: Product retrieved successfully. Includes category, pharmacist_price, customer_price, discount, and discount_type fields.

put.description: Update product details. Only suppliers from the same company can update.

price.description: Legacy field - kept for backward compatibility

discount.description: Discount amount (percentage or fixed based on discount_type)

discount_type.description: Type of discount: percentage or fixed amount

metadata.description: Additional product information as JSON object

delete.description: Soft delete a product. Only suppliers from the same company can delete.

get.description: Get the authenticated user's profile information

put.description: Update the authenticated user's profile information
Update company information (only for company admins)

get.description: Get a paginated list of stock movements for a specific product

post.description: Add stock to a product. Only suppliers can add stock to their products.

403.description: Forbidden - Only suppliers can add stock

post.description: Adjust stock quantity (can be positive or negative). Only suppliers can adjust stock for their products.

quantity.description: Positive for increase, negative for decrease

reason.example: Stock adjustment due to inventory count

403.description: Forbidden - Only suppliers can adjust stock

sanctum.description: Enter your bearer token in the format: Bearer {token}
